digest.component_or_area: fetcher enrichment error handling for Cloud adapter
propositions: RunawayPaginationError subclasses RuntimeError instead of BackendPaginationStallError, causing it to bypass the three re-raise clauses in fetch_snapshot
The three enrichment fail-open handlers (parent, comment, issuelink) at fetcher.py catch the broad Exception type and swallow RunawayPaginationError instead of propagating it
A stalled Cloud cursor produces a silently degraded snapshot with missing enrichment data instead of aborting the pass
The fix changes RunawayPaginationError to subclass BackendPaginationStallError, making it catchable by existing re-raise clauses while preserving RuntimeError in the MRO for backward compatibility
Existing except RunawayPaginationError and except RuntimeError handlers remain unaffected by the inheritance change
